faq.a: The event is exclusively for mgm technology partners Vietnam employees (mgmies) and team members.
No mandatory dress code! You can wear anything comfortable. However, traditional Bavarian attire (Lederhosen or Dirndl) is highly encouraged to enhance the festive atmosphere.
Click the 'Register Now' button on the website to fill out the registration form. You will need your name, work email, and preferred office location.
The RSVP deadline is Friday, 30 August 2026. Make sure to register before this date!
The event takes place simultaneously at two locations: mgm Danang Office & Terrace (71 Quang Trung, Hai Chau District) and mgm HCMC Lounge (195A Hai Ba Trung, District 3).

faq.q: What time does the event start?
faq.a: The event starts at 5:00 PM on Saturday, 19 September 2026 and goes on until late.
Yes! Enjoy premium German-style craft beers, crispy Schweinhaxe (pork knuckle), grilled Bratwurst sausages, warm pretzels with specialty mustard, and more.
Live music performances, beer stein holding challenges, interactive mini-games, a photo booth, and more fun activities throughout the evening.

faq.q: Can I attend at a different office than where I work?
faq.a: Please select the office where you plan to attend during registration. If you have special circumstances, contact the event team.
The event is organized by the mgm Vietnam marketing team. Contact vn_marketing@mgm-tp.com for any questions.

history.note: Over 62 curated memories from past Oktoberfest celebrations. Browse the Memories section on the website to relive the highlights.
